dedupe_keys.name: simple simple one zone building energy model

description: Simple Simple is a Python implementation of a one-capacity, one-resistance building heat model derived from ISO 13790. Its README documents the equations, heat-transfer parameters, heating and cooling set points, a package installation path and a one-step usage example. Users provide floor area, outside temperature, thermal mass, conductance and HVAC limits; outputs are the modelled indoor temperature and required heating or cooling power. The model describes a generic conditioned space, not a particular building stock. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing. A limitation is that the repository intentionally omits windows, ventilation, solar gain and internal gain, so it cannot stand in for a full building retrofit assessment. Its small state space is useful for testing controller logic or coupling demand to district-energy models. The catalogue's EnergyPlus model addresses more detailed building physics. No package or weather data was downloaded.
inputs: Outdoor temperature, one-zone thermal parameters and HVAC set points
name: Simple Simple one-zone building energy model
